Accroches écrites : « How to never run out of things to say with a girl you like » (retenue : le gagnant 409a91e1, avec « you like » pour l'enjeu), « Things that make you surprisingly fun to talk to » (écartée : perd la cible), « How to keep a conversation with her going » (écartée : sans intensif). Items neufs, sans reprendre ceux de 409a91e1, 51759eba, 114f61ce ni d'ay-o002 : remarquer ce qui entoure, donner un petit avis, parler de ce qui passionne, rappels de blagues, ses projets, assumer un blanc. slides.texte_overlay:
How to never run out of things
to say with a girl you like

Notice the little things around you. The weird painting on the wall, the song that just came on, the dog at the next table. "Okay, that dog is clearly running this place." The room is full of things to talk about.

Share a small opinion about something light. "Breakfast for dinner is the best meal there is." Little opinions give her something to agree with, argue with or laugh at. Facts end chats. Opinions start them.

Tell her about something you're into right now. The show you can't stop watching, the recipe you keep messing up. People who are excited about something are easy to talk to, and that energy is contagious.
Always have a story in your back pocket. Five minutes a day of history, art or science and you're never stuck. "Did you know sea otters hold hands while they sleep?" Instant smile, instant new topic.
slides.texte_sophia: Always have a story in your back pocket. A micro-learning app like the Sophia app gives you five minutes a day of history, art or science. You'll never run out of things to say again.

slides.texte_overlay: Use callbacks. Something funny she said ten minutes ago? Bring it back later. "Okay, but this coffee is not at your grandma's level." Inside jokes after one hour make it feel like you've known each other for years.

Ask about her plans, not just her past. "What's the next trip you really want to take?" Talking about what someone is looking forward to lights them up way more than going through what they did last year.
Be fine when the topic runs out. Smile and say "Okay, I've officially run out of material." She laughs, the pressure is gone, and the next topic usually shows up on its own a few seconds later.
